acceptance_criteria: All-failed and mixed segment cycles persist typed failed or partial outcomes and do not advance authoritative success freshness.
Outer, accounting, and ledger-write failures expose bounded stage and cause without raw exception prose.
Restart rehydrates latest attempt, latest success, current failure, and observation coverage from durable evidence.
Disabled, not-started, no-work, current, partial, failed, stale, unreadable, and legacy-unclassified states remain distinguishable.
Enrichment exposes extracted, queued, remotely confirmed, and acknowledged milestones without claiming #2567's export-queue owner responsibilities.
The run-ledger schema shared with #2568 preserves distinct enrichment and consolidation counters and success predicates.
Detailed rows have bounded retention or rollup, and retention and observation failures affect health.
Exact-byte tests prove identities, content, provider output, and raw exceptions do not cross durable, health, log, alert, or console boundaries.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified by a typed durable cycle outcome consumed during health construction and restart, with success freshness advanced only from authoritative success. Exact-main source instead preserves process-local nullable freshness and success-shaped accounting after caught failures. Crash, ledger-write, unreadable-ledger, mixed-segment, and cross-boundary export fault injection remains an implementation-time obligation.
impact: Completely or partially failed enrichment can be recorded as success, refresh the apparent success clock, or restart into healthy/null while durable failure evidence is ignored; queue admission can also be mistaken for exported memory.
